filling a fennel-stalk, hidden in a fennel-stalk
filling a fennel-stalk, hidden in a fennel-stalk

Hesychius explains the word, no doubt formed by Aeschylus, as τὴν ἐν νάρθηκι θησαυρισθείσαν [the one stored in a fennel-stalk], because they used the fennel-stalk for rekindling fire. Thus Hesiod Theog. 565 ἀλλά μιν (Ἰovem) ἐξαπάτησεν ἐυς πάϊς Ἰαπετοῖο | κλέψας ἀκαμάτοίο πυρὸς τηλέσκοπον αὐγὴν | ἐν κοίλῳ νάρθηκι [but the good son of Iapetus deceived him, stealing the far-seen gleam of untiring fire in a hollow fennel-stalk].
